climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: An Andalusia appellation in Seville province, covering the municipalities of Lebrija and El Cuervo de Sevilla. It is a Vino de calidad ranking below Denominación de Origen. Rules allow wine from Palomino, Moscatel and Tempranillo among others.
